artworks.title: A Cow Standing and Another Lying Down
artworks.description: The image shows a view from ground level of two cows in a field. One cow is standing on the left, looking at the viewer, while the other is reclining on the grass to the right. The horizon is near the top with faint indications of a distant landscape. The illustration is detailed with fine linework using hatching and cross-hatching for texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, emphasizing light and dark contrasts.

artworks.title: Cow Lying Down near a Fence
artworks.description: This is an image of a cow lying next to a fence. The cow is resting on a slightly elevated patch of ground, with its front legs tucked beneath its body and its head slightly lowered. The cow's fur texture and shadows accentuate its form. It has prominent horns and calm eyes. A wooden fence is to the right, showing signs of age. In the background, there are faint horizontal lines suggesting a landscape with trees or bushes. The sky is minimally detailed with a bird flying in the distance. The linework creates a tranquil rural scene.

artworks.title: Grazing Cow
artworks.description: The image shows two cows in a rural setting. One cow is standing and grazing in the center, while another cow is lying down to the left under a tree. In the background, there is a church spire on the right. The black and white etching features detailed lines to create texture and depth in the scene, with a clear sky above.

artworks.title: Standing Cow (Cow with a Crumpled Horn)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cow in a pastoral landscape. The cow is shown with crosshatching for texture and musculature details on its flank and neck. Its head is slightly lowered, with shadow details rendered intricately. Beside the cow are vegetation and a fallen tree log. The background includes open fields with a small structure in the distance. The line work is precise and detailed, adding to the rustic and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Pissing Cow
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a cow on the right and two sheep on the left. The horizon is low, with some buildings and trees far in the distance. The animals are detailed with fine lines, creating a textured look. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black and white shades for depth and form, with shadows and texture created by cross-hatching. Birds are flying in the sky above the rural scene.

artworks.title: Two Oxen Fighting
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two cows grazing in a pasture. The image features two cows positioned with their heads down, suggesting they are grazing or interacting with the ground. The cows have carefully detailed body structure and fur texture. The background shows some trees on the horizon line and a clear sky. The drawing is created using detailed line work and shading to give depth and dimension, creating a serene and pastoral atmosphere. The scene conveys a sense of rural tranquility and simplicity.

artworks.title: Two Cows Seen from Behind
artworks.description: Two large cows, one standing and the other lying down next to a wooden fence. The image is rendered in black ink with detailed linework. The standing cow is on the left facing away, while the lying cow is on the right facing right. In the background, some small human figures are walking towards the horizon.

artworks.title: Odysseus and Teiresias
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white, over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 24.6 x 41.5 cm (9 11/16 x 16 5/16 in.)
support: 33.8 x 50.4 cm (13 5/16 x 19 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures and creatures in a dramatic scene. The image shows a group of figures interacting, with some appearing to be in conflict. In the forefront, two figures are engaged in physical struggle, surrounded by other figures in various postures. The setting is an ambiguous cavernous environment with distant figures and rocky formations. The medium used is likely ink and wash, with a limited color palette.

artworks.title: Figures (Christ Calling One of the Apostles?)
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing featuring several figures in a natural and architectural setting. It shows three figures dressed in flowing garments around a central tree, with a structure resembling an arch in the background. The drawing is done in a soft, sketchy style emphasizing movement and interaction, with shadows and outlines providing depth and dimension.

artworks.title: Venus as a Huntress Appearing to Aeneas and Achates
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper, traces of red chalk upper left
artworks.description: This is a drawing of classical figures and a cherub. The drawing depicts several figures in classical attire. The central figures are engaged in an interaction, with one pointing towards a cherub or putto floating above them. The composition is lively, with fluid lines and an expressive portrayal of motion. The surrounding environment includes loosely sketched foliage.

artworks.title: Venus Appearing to Achilles
artworks.description: The image is an intricate drawing of a classical scene with three figures beneath a tree. The figures are shown standing and wearing various classical garments. One figure holds a spear, another gazes upwards, and the third has a raised arm. A cherub-like figure with wings is shown in movement above them, along with a child supported by foliage. The facial features are delicately drawn, and the scene is set outdoors with tree foliage and clouds. The composition is enclosed within an oval frame with Latin inscriptions below it.

artworks.title: The Virgin with the Rose
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black and brown
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body view of a person holding a small child on their lap. The person's head is turned slightly to the side, with their facial features detailed through delicate line work, and their hair in an updo. The clothing is depicted with loose, flowing lines, suggesting a robe or similar garment, with additional folds around the shoulders and chest. The small child has curly hair and is facing the person. Nearby, there is another small figure with curly hair leaning forward. The background is filled with ornamental foliage forming a circular frame around the figures. The composition is rendered in a style reminiscent of an etching, with fine lines and cross-hatching providing depth.

artworks.title: Maid with a Mousetrap
artworks.description: Two people are shown from the waist up in a dimly lit setting. The person on the right is seated and holding a large candle, while the person on the left has long, wavy hair and is dressed in a similar outfit. They are gathered around a small table or ledge with various objects, including a candlestick. The setting is framed by a window or large opening draped with a curtain, casting shadows.

artworks.title: Apollo on Mount Parnassus
artworks.artist: Etienne Delaune after Niccolò dell' Abate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of mythical creatures gathered in a forest setting. The scene depicts figures, some playing musical instruments. There is a central figure seated on a rock playing a stringed instrument. Surrounding this central figure are other figures holding tambourines and books. A mystical animal is positioned in the background. The woodland surrounds the scene, implying a secluded location for this assembly. The style suggests it is a detailed work reflecting Renaissance influences, with intricate etching and cross-hatching techniques providing depth and texture.

artworks.title: Narcissus at the Fountain
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with classical elements and inscriptions. The image depicts a composition with ornate architectural structures, including pillars, arches, and pedestals. There is a prominent sculpture of a figure atop one of the structures and intricate detailing in the carvings that ornament the buildings. A fountain with a sculptured creature is present near the bottom. The drawing contains Latin text below. The intricate linework and careful attention to architectural details highlight the stylized beauty of the structures and the garden-like setting surrounding them.

artworks.title: The Sleeping Shepherd; Early Morning
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclining inside a shaded structure, with architectural elements and textures surrounding them. Near the top third of the image, a farmer and an oxen are silhouetted against the sky. The landscape features rolling hills, trees, and birds flying in the sky. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on shades of black and grey to highlight textures and forms through light and shadow.

artworks.title: Charles-Rene d'Hozier
artworks.description: The image displays a man seated in a dignified pose. He has long, curly hair and wears an outfit typical of the late 17th to early 18th century. He is adorned with a medal or cross around his neck and is surrounded by papers on a table. The background includes a drapery, a column, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Alcune Prospettive
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing displays an ornate architectural structure featuring decorative elements and text. The symmetrical design includes fluted columns with intricate capitals, a decorative entablature, elegant script in Italian, an inscription by Giuseppe Antonio Landi, a sculpted bust within an arched niche, decorative scrollwork, urns with plant arrangements on top of the entablature, and detailed linework typical of classical architectural illustrations.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy with Obelisks, Ruins, and a Piazza
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of classical architectural ruins. The scene shows a grand, symmetrical composition with classical architectural elements like columns, entablatures, and pediments. At the center background, there is a domed building. In the foreground, there are overturned and scattered stone blocks, suggesting ruins that lead towards the central structure. Two obelisks stand in the middle ground, surrounded by classical motifs such as urns and stone carvings. The sky has horizontal strokes indicating clouds. The image conveys grandeur and historical majesty, typical of classical architecture, with a play of light and shadows enhancing detail and depth.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy with Arched Gateways
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a detailed architectural drawing, offering a perspective view from within a grand, columned structure. The point of view is from ground level, looking into a space that is open to the sky beyond. In the distance, the horizon is mostly obscured by the continuing structure and distant walls. The artwork utilizes precise linework to create depth and texture, providing a sense of realism and intricate use of hatching for shading and detail. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting solely of black ink on white paper. Closest to us are imposing columns supporting large arches, with detailed brickwork and stone textures. Beyond these, various architectural elements are visible, creating a sense of depth within the composition.

artworks.title: Fantastic Garden with a Fountain and a Garden Pavilion
artworks.description: The image displays an architectural scene with a fountain as the focal point. The perspective directs the viewer's gaze towards the detailed fountain in the center, surrounded by topiary trees. Columns frame the scene, leading to a building in the background. The painting features fine lines, cross-hatching, and a monochromatic palette emphasizing light and shadow contrasts.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy with Classical Ruins and Vernacular Buildings
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows ancient architectural ruins from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high, below a textured sky with clouds. The main focus is a pair of large columns in the center, surrounded by other structures. Additional buildings with varying rooflines and arches are visible. The scene includes architectural debris and fallen columns. The background shows mountainous forms for depth. The drawing style uses fine lines and shading for texture in a black and white etching style. The color palette is predominantly greyscale, emphasizing light and shadow contrast.

artworks.title: Fantastic Townscape with Ruins
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white engraving of an architectural ruin scene. The perspective is slightly elevated, offering a comprehensive view of ancient structures. The foreground features a large column, scattered stone blocks, and a central obelisk. The engraving is detailed, with precise lines showing the bricks, columns, and arches of the structures. Various architectural elements are depicted, including statues on columns and domed and arched buildings. The monochrome palette emphasizes the contour lines and shading, adding depth and texture to the scene.

artworks.title: Triumphal Arch in a Landscape
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features an architectural arch framing a statue. The horizon line aligns with the base of the arch, where a sculpted figure stands on a pedestal holding a flag. The arch is detailed with classical elements like columns and decorative urns. Surrounding the structure are trees and greenery, creating a park-like setting extending into the distance. The illustration is monochrome with intricate lines and hatching, emphasizing the contrast between the elements and enhancing the depth of field. The absence of vivid colors highlights the design's intricacy and the blend of architecture with nature.
